referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Includes the whole manufacturing process to produce clay plaster (raw material provision, raw material mixing, packing, and storage), transports to plant, and infrastructure. No requirements for administration are included. No additional buildings and land-use have been taken into account as it is assumed that the mixing process takes place in an existing building of the sand/cement industry or on the construction site
referenceFunction.name: Clay plaster, at plant

geography.text: The amount of raw materials is based on estimations. The transportation distance is an estimation. For the infrastructure RER- and for the silica sand DE-modules are used as proxy

technology.text: Assumed average current technology. The raw materials are mixed in a certain ratio, transported to the packing installation and packed.
